releaseNotes: We're always working to make APCOA FLOW better for your parking and EV charging experience. Enjoy smoother, more reliable app performance with this update.
description:
APCOA FLOW is a mobile parking app that makes every car park visit easier, from finding a parking space to paying for parking and managing your session after you leave. Whether you're commuting, travelling, shopping or charging your electric vehicle, you can manage your parking, pay by phone, access EV chargers, and store your parking information in one convenient mobile app. 

With cashless mobile payments, digital parking management and flexible parking services, APCOA FLOW helps you spend less time managing parking and more time getting where you need to go.

Why use APCOA FLOW?

Enjoy cashless parking at participating APCOA FLOW car parks. Pay for parking quickly and conveniently from your phone, without needing cash or payment machines. At participating ANPR car parks with AutoPay enabled, simply drive in and drive out while your parking payment is processed automatically using your registered payment method.

Start, stop and extend parking from your phone. If your meeting overruns or your train is delayed, you can extend your parking session remotely without returning to your vehicle.

Receive parking reminders before your session expires, helping you stay in control of your parking and avoid unnecessary stress.

Find nearby car parks and parking spaces using the integrated map, making it easier to choose where to park before you arrive.

Manage season tickets, parking sessions and history  in one place, giving regular parkers a quicker and more convenient parking experience.

Faster, Cashless Parking Payments from your phone

Paying for parking is just as easy as managing it, with secure mobile payments and flexible payment options designed around your parking journey. Pay by phone instead of using cash or a payment machine, helping you get on with your day more quickly. 

Choose from a range of payment options including Apple Pay, or save multiple payment methods for faster checkout whenever you park.

LatePay lets you pay for eligible parking after you've left participating locations, giving you extra flexibility if you've forgotten to pay before leaving. 

Register for AutoPay and, at participating ANPR locations, your number plate is recognised automatically. Simply drive in and drive out while your parking payment is processed from your registered payment method.

Plus you can access digital VAT receipts and your parking history in the app, making it easier to manage expenses, business travel and previous parking sessions.

EV Charging:

Locate available EV charging spots and compatible EV chargers while choosing where to park. Plan your parking and charging together in one journey, no need to use multiple apps. 

Parking and EV charging are managed as separate sessions within APCOA FLOW, giving you a clear overview of parking charges and charging costs. 

Everything in One Parking App

Save multiple vehicles in one account to make regular parking management quick and easy. View active parking sessions, season tickets  and account details whenever you need them.

Keep your parking history, mobile payments, digital receipts, vehicles and account information together in one secure app, making every car park visit simpler from arrival to departure.

APCOA Offers 

Access exclusive rewards and partner discount offers through APCOA FLOW, including offers on hundreds of popular brands like Halfords, Kwik Fit, National Tyres, Charlotte Tilbury, M&S, Merlin, Amazon, and more! 

Download APCOA FLOW today for convenient car park parking, flexible pay by phone payments, secure mobile wallet checkout, EV charging and complete digital parking management in one app.
